answer: Random mutual audit blocks bulk fake identities. A new identity locks a 60-unit bond and faces 3 auditors checking its work log and counterparties. A copied log stands out like plastic plants in a garden. A rushed record fails checks like cheap metal at a forge. Auditors approving a fake lose their bond. Making 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 units; one honest identity pays 60 once and keeps undiluted rewards; hidden links surface through karst.
